purpose: Test whether a shared director manifest improves adoption, usable output, continuity, rework, cost, and lead time when the visual style changes.

matrix.comparison: For each cell, compare an approved manifest-driven production contract with a direct single-prompt baseline using the same backend, duration, ratio, reference allowance, and generation budget.

primary_metrics.label: 导演预案采用率
primary_metrics.definition: approved scenes retained without narrative restructuring / proposed scenes

primary_metrics.label: 可用片段率
primary_metrics.definition: clips accepted for edit after at most one targeted correction / generated clips

primary_metrics.label: 每成片分钟重做数
primary_metrics.definition: all replacement generations / delivered video minutes

primary_metrics.label: 单条采用成本
primary_metrics.definition: generation plus retry cost / accepted clips

primary_metrics.label: 每成片分钟耗时
primary_metrics.definition: elapsed human plus machine production time / delivered video minutes

secondary_checks: voiceover omission, repetition, or timing mismatch
unsafe crop at the target aspect ratio

decision_required_before_execution.question: Which video backend and version will be the first controlled target?
decision_required_before_execution.why: Prompt syntax, reference support, duration, cost, and reproducibility depend on it.

decision_required_before_execution.question: What is the maximum generation and retry budget?
decision_required_before_execution.why: The 9-cell matrix needs a hard stop and comparable attempts per condition.

decision_required_before_execution.question: Which owned reference boards or keyframes may be used for each style?
decision_required_before_execution.why: A named style without approved visual references is not a reproducible production condition.

decision_required_before_execution.question: Who approves narrative fidelity, style fidelity, and edit usability?
decision_required_before_execution.why: Separate reviewer roles reduce hindsight bias and make rejection reasons comparable.

execution_stages: Freeze source, director manifest, ratio, duration, backend version, reference allowance, seed policy, and budget.
Create one baseline and one manifest-driven contract for every matrix cell.
Blind-review narrative fidelity, style fidelity, continuity, technical defects, and edit usability.
Allow at most one targeted correction before classifying a clip as accepted or rejected.
Report medians, failure reasons, and confidence limits; do not generalize from a showcase sample.
Only expand automation if the manifest-driven condition improves usable rate or rework without unacceptable cost.
current_boundary: No backend, budget, owned reference set, or reviewer panel has been selected. Project 008 therefore stops at a reproducible protocol and does not spend generation credits or claim visual outcomes.
